title: Organization
summary: ORGANIZA'TION, noun 1. The act or process of forming organs or instruments of action. 2. The act of forming or arranging the parts of a compound or complex body in a suitable manner for use or service

inlines.v: ORGANIZA'TION, noun 1. The act or process of forming organs or instruments of action. 2. The act of forming or arranging the parts of a compound or complex body in a suitable manner for use or service; the act of distributing into suitable divisions and appointing the proper officers, as an army or a government. The first organization of the general government. 3. Structure; form; suitable disposition of parts which are to act together in a compound body.
